subject: physics
title: Magnetic Fields due to Electric Current

stops.title: Lorentz force & cyclotron motion
stops.inShort: Magnetic force on moving charge: F = q(v × B). Lorentz force: F = q(E + v × B). In a uniform perpendicular B, charge moves in a circle of radius r = mv/(qB) with cyclotron frequency f = qB/(2πm).

stops.title: Force on current-carrying wire & Moving Coil Galvanometer
stops.inShort: Force on wire: F = I (L × B). Torque on current loop: τ = N I A B sin θ. In a radial-field MCG, deflecting torque N I A B balances restoring torque k θ, so θ ∝ I.

stops.title: Biot-Savart law & circular loop
stops.inShort: Biot-Savart law: dB = (μ₀/4π)(I dl sin θ / r²). At the centre of a circular arc subtending θ: B = μ₀ I θ / (4π R); for full circle (θ = 2π): B = μ₀ I / (2R). Force per unit length between parallel currents: f/L = μ₀ I₁ I₂ / (2π d).

stops.title: Ampere's circuital law, solenoid & toroid
stops.inShort: Ampere's law: ∮ B·dl = μ₀ I_enclosed. Inside a long straight solenoid: B = μ₀ n I (n = N/L). Inside a toroid: B = μ₀ n I = μ₀ N I / (2π R).

items.f: F = q(v × B),  r = m v / (q B),  f = q B / (2π m)
items.s: Magnetic force does zero work on a moving charge.

items.f: B_arc = μ₀ I θ / (4π R),  B_centre = μ₀ N I / (2 R)
items.s: On axis of circular loop: B = μ₀ I R² / [2(R² + z²)^(3/2)].
n = turns per unit length (N/L for solenoid, N/(2πR) for toroid).

board.text: What is the work done by an external uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the velocity of a moving charge?
board.answer: Zero. The magnetic force F = q(v × B) is always perpendicular to the velocity v (and displacement), so W = F · ds = 0.

points.text: Zero work done (force is perpendicular to velocity/displacement)

board.text: State the formula for magnetic induction produced by a current in a circular arc of a wire. Hence find the magnetic induction at the centre of a current carrying circular loop.
board.answer:
Magnetic induction at the centre of a circular arc of radius R subtending angle θ (in rad): B = μ₀ I θ / (4π R).
For a full circular loop, θ = 2π.
Substituting θ = 2π: B = μ₀ I (2π) / (4π R) = μ₀ I / (2 R).

points.text: Formula for circular arc: B = μ₀Iθ / (4πR)

board.text: Obtain an expression for magnetic induction of a toroid of 'N' turns about an axis passing through its centre and perpendicular to its plane.
board.answer:
Consider a circular Amperian loop of radius r inside the core of the toroid (circumference 2πr). Magnetic field B is tangential everywhere along the loop.
By Ampere's circuital law: ∮ B·dl = μ₀ I_enclosed ⇒ B(2πr) = μ₀ N I.
Therefore B = μ₀ N I / (2π r) = μ₀ n I, where n = N/(2πr) is turns per unit length.

points.text: Amperian loop of radius r with ∮ B·dl = B(2πr)
I_enclosed = NI giving B = μ₀NI/(2πr) = μ₀nI

board.text: Explain the principle, construction and working of a Moving Coil Galvanometer (MCG).
board.answer:
Principle: A current-carrying coil suspended in a uniform radial magnetic field experiences a torque τ = N I A B.
Construction: Rectangular coil of N turns wound on a light frame, suspended in a radial magnetic field between concave pole pieces with a soft iron core inside.
Working: Deflecting torque τ_d = N I A B is balanced by restoring torque τ_r = k θ of the suspension fibre. At equilibrium, N I A B = k θ ⇒ I = (k / NAB) θ, so deflection θ ∝ I.
